title: File:Mount Sturgeon & Mount Abrupt.jpg
claims: The photograph looks across green paddocks and a line of trees in the Wannon River valley towards Mount Sturgeon on the left and Mount Abrupt on the right, with a blue sky and scattered cloud; the file page gives no camera coordinates.

Commons titles the photograph Mount Sturgeon & Mount Abrupt.jpg and describes it as looking across the Wannon River valley to the two peaks at Dunkeld, Victoria; it shows the final climbs and their setting, not the GPT100 finish line, finish chute, aid station, course marking or race-day crowd.
The author is Melburnian; the file is licensed CC BY 3.0; the photograph was taken on 2009-11-07; the original is 1,333 x 1,000 pixels and 1,030,035 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 172,024 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Melburnian, CC BY 3.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
